messages.author: 261c2dfd4c6766de
messages.subject: SparkR installation on Windows 7 fails
parts:
Hi,
I'm having the same problem as the Original Poster had.

I'm using R 3.1.3 on Windows 7.
Also I'm using spark version 1.2.1, maven 3.1.1
My Path variables are as follows;
JAVA_HOME= C:\Program Files\Java\jdk1.7.0_79
M2_HOME = D:\apache-maven-3.1.1
MAVEN_HOME= D:\apache-maven-3.1.1
SPARK_VERSION= C:\Program Files\spark-1.2.1
SBT_HOME= C:\Program Files (x86)\
 and 
PATH= C:\Program Files (x86)\scala\bin;HADOOP_HOME = D:\winutils;%M2_HOME%\bin;%MAVEN_HOME%\bin;%JAVA_HOME%\bin;%SPARK_VERSION%bin;

I can see the maven version when I execute mvn -version but when i try to download and install SparkR from R using the commands

>library(devtools)
>library(rJava)
> install_github("amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg", subdir="pkg")
I get the following error, 

Downloading github repo amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg@master
Installing SparkR
"C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-31~1.3/bin/x64/R" --no-site-file --no-environ --no-save  \
  --no-restore CMD INSTALL "C:/Users/ashish  \
  dutt/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpsLJ1kC/devtools180c26344ee3/amplab-extras-SparkR-pkg-e532627/pkg"  \
  --library="C:/Users/ashish dutt/Documents/R/win-library/3.1"  \
  --install-tests 

* installing *source* package 'SparkR' ...
** libs
  running 'src/Makefile.win' ...
mvn.bat -Dhadoop.version=1.0.4 -Dspark.version=C:\Program Files\spark-1.2.1 -Dyarn.version=2.4.0 -DskipTests clean package shade:shade
make: mvn.bat: Command not found
make: *** [target/sparkr-0.1-assembly.jar] Error 127
Warning: running command 'make --no-print-directory -f "Makefile.win"' had status 2
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'SparkR'
* removing 'C:/Users/ashish dutt/Documents/R/win-library/3.1/SparkR'
Error: Command failed (1)


Any help would be appreciated.
Thank you
Ashish

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: SparkR installation on Windows 7 fails
parts:
The error here is that the file `mvn.bat` is not found. You can try to upgrade your Maven version as that seemed to help for somebody else in the other thread. You can also add a symlink from mvn.cmd (which I guess exists in older Maven versions) to mvn.bat 

Also the SparkR development has now moved to the Apache Spark project -- So please send questions to the Spark user mailing list (http://spark.apache.org/community.html)

Thanks
Shivaram

parts:
Dear Shivaram,
Greetings.
First of all, thank you so much for your response. Second, thank you again for the pointer.
I solved the problem by downloading Maven version 3.3.3 and configured the environment variables accordingly.
I will be posting a detailed solution to this problem on my blog today. And thank you for letting me know of the spark user community mailing list. I was not aware of it.

Cheers,
Ashish

Sincerely,
Ashish Dutt
PhD Candidate
Department of Information Systems
University of Malaya, Lembah Pantai,
50603 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
